No, a court would not enforce the bar against assignment of the right to receive the $30,000. Under UCC §2-210(2)–(3), a general prohibition on assigning "the contract" bars only delegation of performance, and the right to payment for the distributor's completed performance can be assigned despite the clause. The clause may still give the treatment center a breach claim against the distributor, but that does not undo the assignment.

CONFIDENCE: 80
